title: DataMeshy Domain Registry Entry
description: JSON Schema (Draft 7) for validating domains/*.yaml registry files. Each file represents one onboarded domain.

domain_name.description: Unique domain identifier (snake_case). Must match the filename (domains/{domain_name}.yaml).

account_id.description: AWS account ID for this domain (12-digit string).

aws_region.description: AWS region where this domain's infrastructure is deployed (e.g., ap-southeast-2).

owner_email.description: Email address of the domain owner or on-call team.

github_repo.description: Full GitHub repository slug for the domain repo (org/repo).

repo_pattern.description: Glob pattern used by platform workflows to locate domain product repos.

onboarded_at.description: ISO 8601 date when the domain was onboarded to the mesh (YYYY-MM-DD).
